ordered_acceptance.Verus+Z3: pending for the public host-device/view orchestration; wgpu object lineage, Surface/swapchain behavior and Vello submission are third-party TCB
ordered_acceptance.Proptest: not applicable to live wgpu object creation in the current property harness; format/layout kernels retain their separate proofs
ordered_acceptance.Miri: not applicable: wgpu drivers, threading and GPU APIs are unsupported external execution
ordered_acceptance.cargo-fuzz: not applicable to live Surface/device state; numerical readback/layout paths retain separate fuzz coverage
ordered_acceptance.Kani: not applicable to wgpu driver/device state; readback layout has a separate proven finite kernel
ordered_acceptance.Loom: not applicable inside the engine: the host owns queue/submission synchronization and present; engine-side ownership is a single mutable GpuRenderer

environment.vm: 3G, zero swap, 128 tasks, Cargo jobs=1, default 180-second workload limit
environment.adapter: VM software wgpu adapter (llvmpipe); /dev/dri access denied
environment.actual_window_surface: not tested because the restricted VM has no authorized display endpoint

TCB: host Surface reconfiguration, swapchain texture lifetime, vsync and present
OS window system and GPU driver
limitations: Direct rendering to a host TextureView is implemented; actual window Surface acquire/present/DPI/recovery must still be observed on an authorized display host.
The texture view's true extent and usage are host obligations; the engine checks its requested extent and format but cannot introspect a TextureView's creation descriptor.
No hardware-GPU/device-lost evidence is claimed from the VM's software adapter.
